clips.title: The story
paras: Prairie Wolf Paws are harvested from the predators roaming the plains of Mulgore. Shamanic practitioners, such as Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village, use them as organic components to bind the natural power of the land into cleansing totems.

Prairie wolves stalk the rolling grasses across Mulgore, hunting in packs alongside prairie stalkers and their pack alphas. While dangerous to young hunters and local livestock, the creatures are deeply intertwined with the spiritual balance of the plains. Tauren shamans view the wolf's paws not merely as trophies, but as vital conduits of the earth's innate vitality.

When goblin ventures tainted Mulgore's sacred water reserves, shaman Mull Thunderhorn required the physical aid of the land itself to counteract the pollution. Bound together with plainstrider talons, the wolf paws provide the raw spiritual resonance necessary to fashion cleansing totems, beginning the vital work of purifying the Winterhoof Water Well.
